# Sajda 4.5.1
### Legal and attribution patch - Expanded Acknowledgements (in-app About + README): every dependency now lists its license (all MIT), the transitive MenuBarExtraAccess is credited, bundled adhan audio cites its Public Domain Mark 1.0 sources, city search carries the required OpenStreetMap/ODbL attribution, and the mosque artwork credits Nawicon (Noun Project, CC BY 3.0). - City search backend is now switchable without an app update: a small config file can redirect or disable it if the provider ever asks, per the Nominatim usage policy.
